verdict.rationale: jo is a personal AI agent, so building and sharing custom assistants with their own instructions and knowledge is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no such feature. Scheduled jobs, website publishing and per-household-member private jo instances are different features and do not let a user author or share custom assistants.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can build and share custom assistants with their own instructions and knowledge
